说明: 满分范文（自己写，解析卷范文只作参考）。每段第一句是题目给的开头语（given: true，不计词数）。zh = 中文意思。

paragraphs.en: Daniel and Rachel suggested that Emily continue her journey by train.
paragraphs.zh: 丹尼尔和瑞秋建议艾米丽坐火车继续她的旅程。

paragraphs.en: “The station is only ten miles away, and the trains are still running,” Daniel said.
paragraphs.zh: “车站只有十英里远，火车也还照常运行。”丹尼尔说。

paragraphs.en: Emily hesitated, but the thought of spending Christmas Eve with her boyfriend made up her mind.
paragraphs.zh: 艾米丽犹豫了一下，可一想到能和男朋友一起过平安夜，她就下定了决心。

paragraphs.en: Having spent the night at the couple’s home, Emily was driven at dawn to the station, where Rachel pressed a thermos of hot chocolate into her hands and Daniel promised to have her car pulled out of the ditch.
paragraphs.zh: 在夫妻俩家里住了一晚后，艾米丽天一亮就被送到了车站。在那里，瑞秋把一保温壶热巧克力塞到她手里，丹尼尔则答应找人把她的车从沟里拖出来。

paragraphs.en: As the train pulled away, she waved through the frosted window, tears of gratitude welling up in her eyes.
paragraphs.zh: 火车开动时，她隔着结了霜的车窗挥手，眼里涌出感激的泪水。

paragraphs.en: Three days later, Emily returned to get her car.
paragraphs.zh: 三天后，艾米丽回来取她的车。

paragraphs.en: To her surprise, it was waiting outside the couple’s house, already pulled out of the ditch and scraped clean of snow.
paragraphs.zh: 让她惊讶的是，车就停在夫妻俩家门外，已经从沟里拖了出来，车上的雪也刮得干干净净。

paragraphs.en: Deeply moved, Emily handed them a box of chocolates from Toronto, saying, “You didn’t just save my car; you saved my Christmas.”
paragraphs.zh: 艾米丽深受感动，把一盒从多伦多带来的巧克力递给他们，说：“你们救的不只是我的车，还有我的圣诞节。”

paragraphs.en: Rachel hugged her and said with a wink, “Next time, listen to the weather warnings!”
paragraphs.zh: 瑞秋抱了抱她，眨眨眼说：“下次可得听天气预警！”

paragraphs.en: Driving away under a clear blue sky, Emily realized that the storm had nearly ruined her holiday, yet it had brought her something far more precious: the warmth of strangers.
paragraphs.zh: 在晴朗的蓝天下开车离开时，艾米丽意识到：这场暴风雪差点毁了她的假期，却也给她带来了更珍贵的东西——陌生人的温暖。
